issuer: the Intendencia de Lavalleja, through its traffic office

licence.name: Permiso Único Nacional de Conducir (categoría A)

note: Read 2026-10-30. Ley 18.191 (Tránsito y Seguridad Vial, 2007, as IMPO publishes it in force), art. 26: the licence is issued by the competent traffic authority in each department and every authority recognises the national licence issued in any department. The Congreso de Intendentes' Texto Ordenado of the Permiso Único Nacional de Conducir (PUNC; plenary resolutions of 27/7/2017, 19/12/2019 and 28/7/2022, the file dated 2-2023, published 25/07/2022 on gub.uy), the standard the Intendencias apply: category A (cars and vans up to 9 passengers) from 18; a first permit is provisional, for at most 2 years; afterwards the renewal's maximum term for A falls with age, 10 years up to 55, 9 at 56 down to 1 at 80, and a doctor may set a shorter term. Written: the PUNC category A from 18 for 10 years (the maximum to 55, the term most adults hold after the provisional first 2 years; neither the provisional term nor the shorter terms after 55 is held by the form). Lavalleja's first-issue procedure in the national catalogue costs 1.50 UR, charged by the term granted (20% under 24 months up to 100% over 95 months). The fee is held in UR (the index unit the national statistics institute publishes monthly), worth the UR's value in the month it's paid (from 2026-10-30, when the form took a fee in an index unit; until then it stood null). Lavalleja's full 1.50 UR is the charge for a term over 95 months, as the 10 years held is.

sources.title: Ley 18.191, Ley de Tránsito y Seguridad Vial en el Territorio Nacional (IMPO)

Todas las autoridades competentes reconocerán la licencia nacional de conducir expedida en cualquiera de los departamentos
